content.title: Full Coachella 2026 Week 1 Line-Up: Headliners, Specific Timings, Stage Locations & BigBang's Comeback
content.text: Get your face gems on, partyseekers – it’s Coachella season. Whether you’ve managed to snag tickets to watch the massive music fest in person, or are simply watching it live from the comfort of your home, one thing’s for sure: keeping track of such an extensive line-up almost feels like a part-time job. Especially if you’re part of the former crowd, trying to zoom in on the festival’s massive schedule infographic on a tiny phone screen while in the midst of the desert throng.We’ve got you – here’s a comprehensive list of the Coachella 2026 line-up with specific timings and stage locations, featuring big names like Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter, and more. Simply hit “Ctrl + F” and type in your fave artistes’ names to see when and where exactly they’re performing on the event grounds.P.S.: Check out our guide to watching the Coachella 2026 livestreams, including info on how to get reminders for the performance schedule tailored to your time zone, and where you can buy Coachella merch online even if you’re not located in USA.Headlining Coachella 2026 are:Day 1, Friday April 10: Sabrina Carpenter, 9.05pm to 10.35pm; Anyma, 12amDay 2, Saturday April 11: Justin Bieber, 11.25pmDay 3, Sunday April 12: Karol G, 9.55pmWhen is BigBang performing at Coachella 2026?Korean boy group BigBang will be taking the stage on April 12, Day 3 of Coachella Week 1 , from 10.30pm to 11.30pm at the Outdoor Theatre. This is a big deal for K-pop fans, as it’s the group’s first performance in close to a decade – since December 2017, to be exact. Their much-anticipated appearance at Coachella is a prelude to their upcoming comeback world tour in 2026.Coachella 2026 Week 1 line-upFriday, April 10Coachella StageRecord Safari: 4.15pm to
